test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What will be the amount payable on maturity on a principal of Rs. 12,000, invested for 3 years, at the rate of 10% per annum, compounded annually?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 12000

Rate = 10%

Time = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount = P(1 + R%)t

**Calculation:**

Amount = P(1 + R%)t

⇒ 12000(1 + 10%)3

⇒ 12000(11/10)3

⇒ 12 × 1331

⇒ Rs. 15972

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
